subject: Money
title: Meme Coins
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Meme Coins.

hook.text: Dogecoin started as a joke in 2013. Elon Musk tweeted about it. It reached a $90 billion market cap. Still a joke.

buildup.text: Meme coins have no technology, no use case, and no development team. Their value comes from internet culture and hype.

discovery.text: They function like lottery tickets. Early buyers can make 1,000x returns. Late buyers lose nearly everything.

twist.text: New meme coins launch daily. Insiders pre-buy, hype on social media, then sell when retail investors pile in. Legal.

climax.text: Meme coins reveal crypto's speculative core. When a dog logo outperforms real tech, something is wrong—or very human.

punchline.text: No utility. Pure belief. Pure gambling.

quiz.question: What gives meme coins their value?
